d:
SANAM recreates and brings back the magic of one of the most popular songs of Raj Kapoor & Nargis Dutt from the movie Chori Chori – Yeh Raat Bheegi Bheegi. A romantic unplugged version, this reinterpretation is a must watch for all the couples in love.
Cover Credits:
Vocals: Sanam Puri
Guitars: Samar Puri
Bass: Venky S
Drums: Keshav Dhanraj
DOP: Charudatta Rana
Editor: Samar Puri
